title: MachineGuest
description: Compute resource specification for a Fly Machine.

cpus.description: Number of vCPU cores to allocate. Defaults to 1.

memory_mb.description: Memory in megabytes, must be a multiple of 256. Defaults to 256.

cpu_kind.description: Type of vCPU to use. shared provides burstable performance; performance provides dedicated cores.
